name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native selective routing: GPT-6.1 Sol / High owns architecture and acceptance, Luna handles bounded coding, Terra handles specialty work, and Astra stays manual-only.

interface.shortDescription: Sol owns the route; Luna codes, Terra handles specialty work, and Astra stays manual-only.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps GPT-6.1 Sol / High in the primary session for architecture, judgment-heavy or high-risk implementation, verification, and acceptance. Before the first task tool call, Sol declares a machine-auditable SELECTIVE ROUTE: solo is the default; delegate uses native GPT-6 Luna / High for bounded work and GPT-6 Luna / Max only for fully specified deep technical work, or GPT-6.1 Terra / High for clear writing, visual understanding, visual/interaction checks and authorized browser or desktop operation; audit uses a fresh read-only GPT-6.1 Sol / High review; full combines one bounded implementer or specialty worker with a fresh review only for a broad or high-risk exception. Terra visual checks do not replace final Sol code review. GPT-6 Astra is a manual upgrade option and is never spawned automatically. Public role metadata is authoritative and missing, conflicting, unavailable, or unobservable routing evidence fails closed.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to declare a SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools, then build and verify this feature.
Use solo by default; select delegate, audit, or exceptional full only when the stated risk justifies it.
